svg.title: Main: cumulative provider usage versus peak counted input

cc:Work.dc:title: Main: cumulative provider usage versus peak counted input
cc:Work.dc:description: Cumulative usage: rounded published phase means, no intervals reported. Peak context: saved canonical summary means. 80 live runs per point. A multi-call run can have cumulative input above its single-request budget. These are subsets of final Main. Sources: docs/results/main_20261109/summary.json; docs/experiments/reports/main-phase1-h50-analysis-2026-11-09.md; docs/experiments/reports/main-phase2-h10-analysis-2026-11-09.md; docs/experiments/reports/main-final-analysis-2026-11-09.md

g.text: Main: cumulative provider usage versus peak counted input
main_12_input_accounting | Cumulative usage: rounded published phase means, no intervals reported. Peak context: saved canonical summary means. 80 live runs per point. A multi-call
run can have cumulative input above its single-request budget. These are subsets of final Main.
